digest.component_or_area: backend-neutrality gate and inbound-fields module rooting
propositions: inbound_fields.py must remain at the package root to allow both Cloud and Data Center adapters to share it while maintaining J7's strict sibling-adapter seal
the backend-neutrality exemption comment must be rewritten to explain the permanent architectural reason for the exemption rather than describing it as temporary relocation debt
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira/ would violate J7 by creating a Data Center-to-Cloud adapter import
moving inbound_fields.py to adapters/jira_family/ would violate the mirror rule because root-core consumers cannot import that layer
the exemption's new wording must clarify that the module's root location is the deliberate cost of preserving the DC/Cloud mapper share without opening a sibling-adapter edge
